ColonyCouncil.WishDef.label: a bed for the sick
ColonyCouncil.WishDef.description: Someone who is ill wants a bed set aside for the sick, where they can be looked after. Any bed marked for medical use will do.
ColonyCouncil.WishDef.fulfilledWhen: A bed in the colony is set aside for medical use.

plain.li: I've been coughing all night in the barracks, and nobody else is sleeping either. Could one bed be kept for the sick?
When you're ill here, you lie wherever you usually lie and hope someone remembers you. Mark a bed for the sick.
[trigger:sick] I'm burning up. I'd like to lie down somewhere the doctor will think to look.
[winter] Sick in the middle of winter, and my bed is by the door. A proper sickbed somewhere warm is all I'm asking.
[lowtech] Where I grew up, the sick got a bed by the fire and someone to bring them broth.
[night] It's the middle of the night and I can hear myself wheezing. I'd like to be where someone else can hear it too.
[child] I feel sick. Can I sleep in a special bed, where somebody checks on you?

warm.li: It isn't only for me. Whoever's ill next could use it too, and someone always is.

blunt.li: I'm sick. Give me a bed where the doctor can find me.

cheerful.li: A bed just for being ill in! I'd almost look forward to the next cold.

gloomy.li: If this gets worse, I'd rather not die in the barracks between two snorers.

cold.li: The sick in shared rooms spread it to the healthy. One bed set apart stops that.

plain.li: A bed set apart, and someone looking in on me. I'm already sleeping better.

warm.li: Thank you. I'll be up again soon, and it'll be there for the next one.

blunt.li: Good. Now let me sleep.

cheerful.li: They brought me soup in bed. I could get used to being sick.

gloomy.li: Still sick. At least someone knows where I am.

cold.li: Separating the sick was the correct decision.

plain.li: I coughed my way through it in my own bed. Nobody came.

blunt.li: Got better on my own. No thanks to anyone.

gloomy.li: Next time I'll just lie down in the yard.

plain.li: Still sick, still in the same bed as always.

warm.li: When someone has a moment, about that bed for the sick.

ColonyCouncil.WishDef.label: healroot put by
ColonyCouncil.WishDef.description: A healer or grower in a colony without industrial medicine wants a store of healroot, grown and dried before the next fever.
ColonyCouncil.WishDef.fulfilledWhen: The colony has {TARGET} herbal medicine in stock.

wants.reason: {PAWN_nameDef} knows what healroot can do, and the colony has almost none put by.

plain.li: We've no healroot to speak of. At the next fever we'll be boiling grass and hoping.
Healroot grows if you give it decent soil and some patience. Let me plant a few rows.
[spring] It's planting time. A row of healroot now means medicine all winter.
[fall] If we don't have healroot dried and hung before the frost, we'll be sorry by midwinter.
[afterraid] I used the last of the herbs on the wounded. We need more before the next raid, not after.
[tribal] My grandmother kept a pouch of healroot at her belt her whole life. I'd like a pouch for every one of us.

warm.li: When someone falls ill, I want to have something better than kind words to give them.

blunt.li: No herbs, no medicine. Grow some healroot.

cheerful.li: A whole bed of healroot! It smells awful and it works wonders.

gloomy.li: Someone will get sick this season. Someone always does. I'd like to be ready.

cold.li: Healroot costs a patch of soil. An infection can cost a colonist.

plain.li: Healroot drying in bundles from the rafters. That's a good sight.

warm.li: Thank you. Whoever falls ill next will be glad of it.

blunt.li: Good. Don't eat it.

cheerful.li: Look at all that green! I've already sewn a little pouch for it.

gloomy.li: Enough for a bad winter, maybe.

cold.li: Medical supply adequate for now.

plain.li: Then we'll have to trust to luck when the fevers come.

blunt.li: When someone's sick, don't come asking me for herbs.

gloomy.li: We'll wish we'd planted it.

plain.li: Still hardly any healroot put by.

cold.li: Herbal stock remains low.

ColonyCouncil.WishDef.label: something fresh to eat
ColonyCouncil.WishDef.description: The stores are almost out of vegetables, fruit and grain, and someone has had enough of meat. Weeks without anything green can bring on scurvy.
ColonyCouncil.WishDef.fulfilledWhen: The colony has {TARGET} raw vegetables, fruit or grain in stock.

wants.reason: {PAWN_nameDef} has eaten nothing green in a long while.

plain.li: Meat, meat and more meat. I'd give a lot for a handful of berries.
My gums have started to bleed. I think I need something green.
[trigger:scurvy] My teeth are loose and my old scars ache. The cook says it's the food, and the cook is right.
[winter] Nothing grows out there now, and we didn't put enough by. I'd like to see vegetables in the stores again.
[spring] As soon as the ground thaws, can we plant something we can eat raw? I'm tired of jerky.
[hurt] I'm healing slower than I should. I think I need better food than this.

warm.li: A few potatoes or some berries would do us all good. It doesn't have to be much.

blunt.li: We need vegetables. Grow some or buy some.

cheerful.li: I dreamed about a bowl of corn last night. Just corn. It was wonderful.

gloomy.li: We'll all go soft in the teeth if this goes on.

cold.li: Our diet is deficient. A stock of vegetables corrects that.

plain.li: Something that crunches. I'd forgotten what that was like.

warm.li: Thank you. I'm sharing these with whoever wants some.

blunt.li: Finally. Pass the berries.

cheerful.li: I ate a raw potato like an apple and I'm not sorry.

gloomy.li: It won't last the winter. But it's something.

cold.li: Diet corrected.

plain.li: More meat, then.

blunt.li: Fine. I'll chew on bark.

gloomy.li: We'll pay for it in teeth.

plain.li: Still nothing fresh in the stores.

cheerful.li: I'd settle for one turnip. Just one.

ColonyCouncil.WishDef.label: an evening with the {SUBJECT}
ColonyCouncil.WishDef.description: Strangers are camped on the map, and someone wants to go over and sit at their fire: news, songs, new faces. Send them over when there's a free evening; the camp keeps count of who visits.
ColonyCouncil.WishDef.fulfilledWhen: {FOR_nameDef} has visited the {SUBJECT}'s camp and talked with them a couple of times.

plain.li: There's a fire burning at the {SUBJECT}'s camp every night. I'd like to go and sit at it.
We haven't heard a new voice in weeks. Let me go over and ask the {SUBJECT} where they've been.
[evening] Hear that? They're singing over at the camp. Let me go, just for tonight.
[winter] Their fire looks warmer than ours somehow. I'd like to see if they'll share it.
[trait:Kind] They must be lonely out there too. I'll take them something and sit a while.
[newcomer] I'm still new here myself. Strangers might be easier to talk to.
[lowtech] Travelers carry news from every road they've walked. I want to hear theirs.

warm.li: They're a long way from home. A friendly face wouldn't hurt them, or me.

blunt.li: I'm going over to the camp tonight. Don't give me work.

cheerful.li: Strangers with stories! I'll bring a bottle and they'll bring the rest.

gloomy.li: They'll be gone soon. If I don't go now, I never will.

cold.li: They know the roads and the neighbors. A few conversations are worth an evening.

plain.li: They had stories about places I'd never heard of. I could have listened all night.

warm.li: They asked me back. I think I'll go.

blunt.li: Good people. Bad stew.

cheerful.li: I learned a song, and I'm teaching it to everyone whether they like it or not.

gloomy.li: Nice people. They'll leave soon, like everyone does.

cold.li: Useful. They've seen a lot of the roads around here.

plain.li: Their fire's still burning over there. I never went.

blunt.li: Missed my chance. Thanks for nothing.

gloomy.li: Strangers come and go, and I stay here.

plain.li: Their fire is still burning over at the {SUBJECT}'s camp.

warm.li: If there's a quiet evening, I'd still like to go over to the camp.

ColonyCouncil.WishDef.label: a council meeting
ColonyCouncil.WishDef.description: Someone has something to put before the council, and the council hasn't sat down together in a long while. Promising it calls a meeting, as calling one from the Ambition page would.
ColonyCouncil.WishDef.fulfilledWhen: The council holds a meeting.

plain.li: It's been weeks since we all sat down together. Things are being decided in passing, at the woodpile.
I have an idea for the colony, and I'd like to say it at a meeting, not shout it across the yard.
I missed the last meeting, and I've been carrying what I meant to say around ever since.
[doubtful] People are starting to wonder whether there's a council at all. Let's meet.
[winter] The nights are long and there's not much to do outside. A good evening for a meeting.
[afterraid] After a raid like that, we should all sit down and decide what comes next.
[bitter] The last time anyone listened to me was the last time we met. Call a meeting.

warm.li: Not to complain. Just to talk, all of us, about where we're going.

blunt.li: Call a meeting. I have things to say.

cheerful.li: Let's have a meeting! I'll bring something to drink, and nobody's allowed to fall asleep.

gloomy.li: I know meetings don't fix much. They're still better than nothing.

cold.li: Decisions made without the council weaken the council. Convene it.

plain.li: Everyone at one table, saying their piece. That's what the council is for.

warm.li: Thank you for hearing us out. All of us.

blunt.li: Good. I said what I came to say.

cheerful.li: Best meeting yet. Nobody threw anything.

gloomy.li: We talked. That's something.

cold.li: The council functions.

plain.li: I'll keep my idea to myself, then.

blunt.li: No meeting. No council, as far as I'm concerned.

gloomy.li: Nobody wants to hear it anyway.

plain.li: Still waiting for the council to sit down together.

blunt.li: The meeting. Any day now.

ColonyCouncil.WishDef.label: a table where everyone fits
ColonyCouncil.WishDef.description: The colony eats in shifts or on its feet. Someone wants chairs at the tables for everyone who eats, so the whole colony can sit down together.
ColonyCouncil.WishDef.fulfilledWhen: There are {TARGET} seats at tables indoors, one for everyone who eats.

plain.li: We eat in turns, like soldiers. I'd like us all at one table, just once a day.
Somebody always eats standing up by the door. There should be a chair for everyone.
[evening] Supper's the only time we're all in one place. It would be nice if we could all sit down for it.
[large] We've grown. The table hasn't. Time we built more chairs.
[newcomer] I don't know where I'm meant to sit, so I eat by the stove.
[trait:Kind] The youngest always ends up eating on the floor. Let's make room for everyone.
[lowtech] Even a long bench would do. We're one people, we ought to eat like one.

warm.li: Sharing a meal makes us a family. Right now we're more like a queue.

blunt.li: Build more chairs. I'm sick of eating standing up.

cheerful.li: A long table with everyone squeezed in and elbows everywhere! That's how meals should be.

gloomy.li: Most days I eat alone because there's nowhere to sit. It wears on you.

cold.li: Seating everyone at once takes less of the workday.

plain.li: Everyone at the table at once. It took me a moment to place the sound.

warm.li: Look at us all. This is how it should be.

blunt.li: Good. Now nobody takes my chair.

cheerful.li: There's room for everyone and the cat still sat in my lap.

gloomy.li: We all fit. For now.

cold.li: Mealtimes are shorter. Good.

plain.li: Back to eating in shifts.

blunt.li: I'll keep standing, then.

gloomy.li: You can feel alone at a table when there's no place at it for you.

plain.li: Still eating in turns.

warm.li: When there's wood to spare, a few more chairs at the table.

ColonyCouncil.WishDef.label: an apprentice in {SUBJECT}
ColonyCouncil.WishDef.description: Someone who knows a skill well wants to pass it on to someone in the colony who is still learning it, often a child. The old ask most. Promising it starts the lessons.
ColonyCouncil.WishDef.fulfilledWhen: {OTHER_nameDef}'s {SUBJECT} skill reaches {TARGET}. Promising pairs {OTHER_objective} with {FOR_nameDef} as a mentor.

plain.li: I've spent my life learning {SUBJECT}. I'd like to teach it to {OTHER_nameDef} before it goes to waste.
{OTHER_nameDef} keeps watching me work. Let me show {OTHER_objective} properly.
[old] I won't be here forever. Somebody should know what I know about {SUBJECT}, and {OTHER_nameDef} is the one I'd pick.
[trait:Kind] {OTHER_nameDef} has a gift for {SUBJECT}. It just needs someone patient.
[evening] I could teach {OTHER_nameDef} in the evenings. An hour a day would do it.
[lowtech] The old teach the young, or what they know dies with them. That's how it's always been done.

warm.li: It would be a pleasure to teach {OTHER_nameDef}. Truly.

blunt.li: Give me {OTHER_nameDef} for an hour a day. I'll make something of {OTHER_objective}.

cheerful.li: {OTHER_nameDef} could be better at {SUBJECT} than me one day! I'd like to see that.

gloomy.li: When I'm gone, someone should still know how to do this.

cold.li: Knowledge held by one person is lost with one arrow. Let me train {OTHER_nameDef}.

plain.li: {OTHER_nameDef} is a quick study. We'll get there.

warm.li: Thank you. It means more than I can say, having someone to teach.

blunt.li: Good. Lessons start at dawn.

cheerful.li: My own apprentice! I've already planned the first lesson.

gloomy.li: At least it won't all be lost.

cold.li: Training has begun.

plain.li: I'll keep it all in my own head, then.

blunt.li: {OTHER_nameDef} can learn the hard way.

gloomy.li: It'll die with me. That's how it goes.

plain.li: {OTHER_nameDef} is still learning {SUBJECT} alone.

gloomy.li: I'm not getting any younger, and there hasn't been a single lesson.

ColonyCouncil.WishDef.label: food that keeps
ColonyCouncil.WishDef.description: Winter is coming, and someone wants food put by that won't spoil: pemmican in a tribe, packaged meals or canned goods later on, whatever the colony can make now.
ColonyCouncil.WishDef.fulfilledWhen: The colony has {TARGET} portions of food that keeps in stock: pemmican, packaged meals, canned goods.

wants.reason: {PAWN_nameDef} wants food put by that won't spoil, for the hungry end of winter.

plain.li: Meals rot. Pemmican doesn't. I'd like a store of something that will see us through when the rest goes bad.
If the stores spoil or the hunters come back empty, what do we eat? Something that keeps, that's what.
[fall] Winter's coming, and the fields will stop. Let's put food by that lasts till spring.
[winter] Midwinter, and the hunting is poor. A store of food that keeps would have saved us some worry.
[lowtech] My people dried meat and berries every autumn and pounded them together with fat. It kept a family through the dark months.
[!lowtech] Packaged meals, canned goods, anything sealed. Food for a bad month.
[poor] We can't afford to waste a single meal. Food that keeps doesn't get wasted.

warm.li: Nobody should go hungry here, not even in the worst of the winter.

blunt.li: Put food by. Food that keeps. Before it's too late.

cheerful.li: A whole shelf of food that'll be just as good in spring! It's like saving silver.

gloomy.li: Every winter someone says we'll be fine. Then we aren't.

cold.li: A reserve of preserved food is insurance against a failed harvest.

plain.li: A shelf of food that will still be good when the snow is deepest. I sleep better.

warm.li: Thank you. Nobody's going hungry this winter.

blunt.li: Good. Don't touch it until we need it.

cheerful.li: I counted it twice. It's all there.

gloomy.li: Enough for a bad winter. Maybe not a very bad one.

cold.li: Reserve established.

plain.li: We'll eat what we have and hope it's enough.

blunt.li: When the stores run out, remember I asked.

gloomy.li: It'll be a hungry spring.

plain.li: Still nothing put by that keeps.

cold.li: No preserved reserve yet.

ColonyCouncil.WishDef.label: a fishing spot
ColonyCouncil.WishDef.description: Odyssey: there are fish in the water on the map and nobody is catching them. Someone who'd like an afternoon at the water's edge, and fish for supper, wants a fishing zone marked out.
ColonyCouncil.WishDef.fulfilledWhen: The colony marks out a fishing zone on the water.

plain.li: There are fish in that water, and we're eating the same stew every night. Let me mark out a spot.
I saw something jump out on the water this morning. A big one. We should be fishing.
[morning] Early morning is when they bite. I'd like to be down at the water at dawn.
[summer] On a day like this, I'd rather be sitting on the bank with a line than anywhere else.
[rain] Fish bite in the rain. Everybody knows that. We should be out there.
[lowmood] An afternoon by the water, with nothing to do but wait for a bite. That's all I want.

warm.li: Fresh fish for everyone, and a quiet hour on the bank for whoever catches it.

blunt.li: Fish in the water, none on the table. Fix that.

cheerful.li: I'll catch the biggest fish anyone's ever seen. Or a boot. Probably a boot.

gloomy.li: The fish will be there long after we're gone. We might as well eat a few first.

cold.li: The water holds food we aren't using. Marking a fishing zone costs nothing.

plain.li: Caught three today. Small ones, but they count.

warm.li: Fish for supper, and I caught it. Thank you.

blunt.li: Good. Leave me alone by the water.

cheerful.li: I caught one this long. All right, this long. It still counts.

gloomy.li: The first one got away. The second didn't.

cold.li: New food source established.

plain.li: The fish will have to wait.

blunt.li: Enjoy the stew.

gloomy.li: Plenty of fish out there. None for us.

plain.li: Still haven't wet a line.

cheerful.li: The fish are still out there, waiting for me.

ColonyCouncil.WishDef.label: {THING} to look at the stars
ColonyCouncil.WishDef.description: A curious mind wants a telescope, to see what's up there.
ColonyCouncil.WishDef.fulfilledWhen: The colony has {THING}, or any other telescope.

wants.reason: {PAWN_nameDef} wants to know what's up there.

plain.li: On clear nights I lie on my back and count the stars. I'd like to see them properly.
There's a whole sky up there and we only ever look at it to check for rain.
[night] Look up. All of that, and we have no way to look closer. Let's build {THING}.
[clear] Not a cloud tonight. It's a waste to look at the sky with bare eyes.
[spacer] Somewhere up there is where we came from. I'd like to find it.
[trait:TooSmart] I've been charting the sky by hand, and I need {THING} to check my numbers.

warm.li: Anyone could use it. There's nothing like a clear night and a good look at the sky.

blunt.li: I want {THING}. The sky is the only thing here that isn't trying to kill us.

cheerful.li: Moons, comets, maybe a passing ship! Build {THING} and I'll show everyone.

gloomy.li: The stars don't care about us. I'd still like to look at them.

cold.li: Observing the sky has value for navigation and for knowledge. The cost is small.

plain.li: I spent half the night at it. There's more up there than I thought.

warm.li: Come and look. I'll show you where to point it.

blunt.li: Good. Don't touch the lens.

cheerful.li: I found a little red star and named it after myself.

gloomy.li: All those worlds, and here we are.

cold.li: A fine instrument.

plain.li: I'll keep squinting, then.

blunt.li: The sky's still there. No thanks to you.

gloomy.li: Nobody here looks up anyway.

plain.li: Clear sky again last night. Still no telescope.

ColonyCouncil.WishDef.label: {THING} by the workbench
ColonyCouncil.WishDef.description: A crafter tired of hunting for the right tool wants a tool cabinet by the bench.
ColonyCouncil.WishDef.fulfilledWhen: The colony has {THING}, or any other tool cabinet.

wants.reason: {PAWN_nameDef} loses an hour a day looking for the right tool.

plain.li: I spend half my time at the bench looking for the right file. Tools need a home.
My good chisel walked off again. A cabinet by the bench, with a place for everything, please.
[work:Crafting] Every job takes twice as long when your tools are spread across three rooms.
[medieval] Every proper workshop has its tools hung on the wall. Ours has a pile on the floor.
[trait:HardWorker|trait:Industrious] I could finish twice as much if I weren't digging through scrap for a hammer.

warm.li: Everyone who works the bench would be glad of it, not just me.

blunt.li: Build {THING}. My tools keep disappearing.

cheerful.li: A place for every tool and every tool in its place! I'd be so happy.

gloomy.li: Someone always borrows the saw and never brings it back.

cold.li: A tool cabinet speeds up work at the bench. It's simple arithmetic.

plain.li: Everything on its hook. I found a chisel I thought I'd lost a season ago.

warm.li: Thank you. The whole workshop runs smoother.

blunt.li: Good. Now nobody touch my tools.

cheerful.li: I've labeled every hook. Twice.

gloomy.li: Now when something goes missing, I'll know exactly what.

cold.li: Efficiency improved.

plain.li: Back to searching the floor.

blunt.li: Don't complain when the work is slow.

gloomy.li: Tools wander off. So does my patience.

plain.li: Lost another hour looking for a file today.

ColonyCouncil.WishDef.label: stone blocks put by
ColonyCouncil.WishDef.description: A builder wants a good stack of stone blocks cut and ready, so stone walls don't wait on the stonecutter.
ColonyCouncil.WishDef.fulfilledWhen: The colony has {TARGET} stone blocks in stock.

wants.reason: {PAWN_nameDef} builds, and wants stone ready before the next job, not after it.

plain.li: Wood burns. Stone doesn't. I'd like a good stack of blocks cut and ready.
Every time we want to build in stone, we wait a week for someone to cut it. Let's cut it ahead of time.
[afterraid] They set fire to the wooden walls again. I want stone ready to rebuild with.
[lowtech] A wall of cut stone will outlast all of us. Let's start cutting.
[work:Construction] I've got a dozen jobs planned and nothing to build them with.
[summer] Summer's the time to cut stone, while the days are long and the ground is dry.

warm.li: With blocks to hand, I could build something that lasts. For all of us.

blunt.li: Cut stone. Lots of it. Then let me build.

cheerful.li: Picture proper stone walls all over the colony! I'll need a lot of blocks.

gloomy.li: Everything we build out of wood ends up burned or rotten.

cold.li: Stone construction lowers the risk of fire and the cost of repairs.

plain.li: A stack of blocks as tall as me. Now I can build properly.

warm.li: Thank you. I'll put them to good use.

blunt.li: Good. Now stay out of my way.

cheerful.li: Look at that pile. I keep walking past it just to look.

gloomy.li: Plenty of stone. Now for the hard part.

cold.li: Material on hand. Construction can proceed.

plain.li: Wood it is, then. Again.

blunt.li: When it all burns down, remember this.

gloomy.li: We'll keep building things that don't last.

plain.li: Still no blocks cut.

ColonyCouncil.WishDef.label: {THING} to dig for ore
ColonyCouncil.WishDef.description: A miner is sure there's ore under the colony, too deep for a pick, and wants a deep drill.
ColonyCouncil.WishDef.fulfilledWhen: The colony has {THING}, or any other deep drill.

wants.reason: {PAWN_nameDef} is sure there's ore under the colony, too deep for a pick.

plain.li: There's ore down there. I can feel it every time I swing a pick. A deep drill would get at it.
We've mined out everything near the surface. The good stuff is further down.
[poor] We're short of steel and sitting on top of who knows what. Let's drill.
[work:Mining] My pick has gone as deep as a pick can go. I need {THING}.
[winter] Nothing to farm in winter, but the ground is still full of metal.

warm.li: Steel, components, whatever is down there, it would help everyone.

blunt.li: Build {THING}. I'll do the rest.

cheerful.li: Who knows what's under our feet? Gold! Probably not gold. Maybe gold.

gloomy.li: Probably nothing down there but rock. I'd still like to find out.

cold.li: The resources underground are untapped. A deep drill pays for itself.

plain.li: Drilling since dawn. The whole ground is humming.

warm.li: Thank you. I'll bring up something worth having.

blunt.li: Good. Now let me dig.

cheerful.li: It goes down and down. I can't wait to see what comes up.

gloomy.li: Found rock so far. Lots of it.

cold.li: Extraction underway.

plain.li: The ore stays where it is.

blunt.li: Fine. Run short of steel, then.

gloomy.li: There was probably nothing there anyway.

plain.li: Still thinking about what's under our feet.

ColonyCouncil.WishDef.label: {THING} to call beyond the hills
ColonyCouncil.WishDef.description: A sociable colonist wants to hear voices from beyond the colony, and to call traders and friends when they're needed.
ColonyCouncil.WishDef.fulfilledWhen: The colony has {THING}, or another comms console.

wants.reason: {PAWN_nameDef} wants to hear voices from beyond the colony, and to call for traders and help.

plain.li: Somewhere out there people are talking, trading, asking for help. We can't hear any of it.
With {THING} we could call the traders instead of waiting for them to wander by.
[afterraid] If we'd had a way to call for help, that raid would have gone differently.
[lowmood] Some nights I'd just like to hear a voice that isn't one of ours.
[small] There are so few of us. I'd feel better if we could call someone.

warm.li: We have friends out there, I'm sure of it. We just need a way to talk to them.

blunt.li: Build {THING}. I'm tired of being cut off.

cheerful.li: Voices from other settlements, right here in the colony! I'll do all the talking.

gloomy.li: If something happens to us, nobody will even know.

cold.li: Communication enables trade, alliances and requests for aid.

plain.li: I heard a trader's voice from three days' walk away. We're not alone out here.

warm.li: Thank you. I've already said hello to half the neighbors.

blunt.li: Good. Now we can ask for things.

cheerful.li: I called a caravan and they're coming, with goods.

gloomy.li: Mostly static. But sometimes there's a voice.

cold.li: Contact established.

plain.li: We'll keep waiting for whoever wanders by.

blunt.li: Enjoy the silence.

gloomy.li: Cut off, then. As we always have been.

plain.li: Still no way to call anyone.

ColonyCouncil.WishDef.label: {THING} to turn back the years
ColonyCouncil.WishDef.description: An older colonist feels the years in every joint and has heard a biosculpter pod can turn some of them back.
ColonyCouncil.WishDef.fulfilledWhen: The colony has {THING}, or another biosculpter pod.

wants.reason: {PAWN_nameDef} feels the years in every joint, and has heard they can be turned back.

plain.li: My knees crack every time I kneel. They say a biosculpter pod can take a few years off. I'd like to find out.
I'm not asking to be young again. A little less old would do.
[hurt] Everything heals slower at my age. A pod could help with that, and with the age too.
[winter] The cold gets into my bones these days. A few cycles in a pod might keep it out.
[spacer] On the worlds I grew up on, nobody my age had to hobble. Build {THING}.

warm.li: It wouldn't only be for me. Everyone here will be my age one day.

blunt.li: I'm old. Build {THING}.

cheerful.li: A few years off! I'd be the youngest old person in the colony.

gloomy.li: I can feel the end coming. I'd like to push it back a little.

cold.li: Reversing my age extends my working life. The colony benefits.

plain.li: I came out of the first cycle and stood up without groaning. That hasn't happened in years.

warm.li: Thank you. I'll be here a while longer, it seems.

blunt.li: Good. Now I'll outlive you all.

cheerful.li: I feel a year younger. I'm going to go and run somewhere.

gloomy.li: It turns the clock back. It doesn't stop it.

cold.li: Biological age reduced. Acceptable.

plain.li: I'll grow old the usual way, then.

blunt.li: Fine. I'll creak.

gloomy.li: Everyone gets old. I'll just get there sooner.

plain.li: My knees still crack every morning.

ColonyCouncil.WishDef.label: a soft chair to rest in
ColonyCouncil.WishDef.description: An old colonist finds the stools hard on their back and wants an armchair to rest in at the end of the day.
ColonyCouncil.WishDef.fulfilledWhen: The colony has {THING}, or another armchair.

wants.reason: {PAWN_nameDef} is getting old, and the stools are hard on {PAWN_possessive} back.

plain.li: At my age, a wooden stool is a punishment. One soft chair by the fire, that's all.
I'd like somewhere to sit at the end of the day that doesn't make my back worse.
[winter] Cold days, long evenings. Somewhere comfortable to sit them out would mean a lot.
[evening] When the work's done, I just want to sink into something soft and watch the others.
[hurt] Everything aches more than it used to. A good chair would help.

warm.li: The young ones could use it too. I'd use it most, I'll admit.

blunt.li: My back hurts. Build {THING}.

cheerful.li: A big soft chair! I'll tell stories from it like a proper grandparent.

gloomy.li: I'll spend more and more of my days sitting. Might as well sit well.

cold.li: Comfort affects recovery. At my age, recovery is slow.

plain.li: I sat down in it and didn't want to get up. I may not.

warm.li: Thank you. Come and sit with me, there's room on the arm.

blunt.li: Good. It's mine.

cheerful.li: It fits me perfectly. I think it was made for me.

gloomy.li: Comfortable. At last.

cold.li: My back is grateful.

plain.li: The stool, then. My back sends its regards.

blunt.li: Fine. I'll complain about my back instead.

gloomy.li: Old bones don't count for much here.

plain.li: Still sitting on the hard stool.

ColonyCouncil.WishDef.label: {THING} for when the time comes
ColonyCouncil.WishDef.description: One of the colony's oldest would rather not leave it to chance where they end up, and wants a proper resting place ready.
ColonyCouncil.WishDef.fulfilledWhen: The colony has {THING}, or another sarcophagus.

wants.reason: {PAWN_nameDef} is old, and would rather not leave it to chance where {PAWN_pronoun} ends up.

plain.li: I've buried enough people out here to know how it goes. I'd like my own resting place ready, and a good one.
Don't look at me like that. Everyone dies. I'd just like to know where I'll lie.
[grieving] Watching them go into the ground made me think. I want a resting place built while I can still see it.
[lowtech] In the old way, the elders chose their own stones. I'd like to choose mine.
[winter] Every winter I wonder whether it's my last. I'd like {THING} ready, just in case.

warm.li: It would spare the rest of you the work, when the time comes.

blunt.li: I'm old. Build me {THING} before I need it.

cheerful.li: I want a nice one, with my name carved big! I'll lie in it to try it out.

gloomy.li: It's coming. I'd rather it found me prepared.

cold.li: A planned burial spares everyone an improvised one. It's practical.

plain.li: I went and looked at it today. Good stone. It'll do.

warm.li: Thank you. Knowing it's there, I worry less.

blunt.li: Good. Don't put anyone else in it.

cheerful.li: I lay down in it to check the fit. Perfect. Then I got up.

gloomy.li: There it is. Waiting.

cold.li: Arrangements complete.

plain.li: A hole in the ground will do, I suppose.

blunt.li: Put me wherever, then.

gloomy.li: Nobody plans for the old.

plain.li: Still no resting place ready.

ColonyCouncil.WishDef.label: lessons in {SUBJECT} from {OTHER_nameDef}
ColonyCouncil.WishDef.description: A child with a gift for a skill wants the colony's best at it to teach them (Biotech).
ColonyCouncil.WishDef.fulfilledWhen: {PAWN_nameDef}'s {SUBJECT} skill reaches {TARGET}. Promising pairs {PAWN_objective} with {OTHER_nameDef} as a mentor.

wants.reason: {PAWN_nameDef} is a child with a gift, and wants to learn it from the best in the colony.

plain.li: {OTHER_nameDef} is the best at {SUBJECT}. Can {OTHER_pronoun} teach me? I'll do my chores first.
I keep watching {OTHER_nameDef} and trying to copy. It would be easier if somebody just showed me.
[evening] Can I have a lesson after supper? Just one? {OTHER_nameDef} said maybe.
[spring] It's nice out. I could learn {SUBJECT} with {OTHER_nameDef} outside.
[lowmood] Everyone's too busy to teach me anything.

warm.li: I want to be as good at {SUBJECT} as {OTHER_nameDef}. Then I can help.

blunt.li: I want lessons. In {SUBJECT}. From {OTHER_nameDef}.

cheerful.li: When I grow up I'm going to be the best at {SUBJECT}! I just need someone to teach me.

gloomy.li: Nobody here has time for kids.

cold.li: If {OTHER_nameDef} teaches me now, I'll be useful sooner.

plain.li: {OTHER_nameDef} showed me how to do it properly. I did it twice by myself.

warm.li: Thank you for letting me learn. I'm going to practice every day.

blunt.li: I'm learning. Don't distract me.

cheerful.li: I'm getting good! {OTHER_nameDef} said so.

gloomy.li: It's harder than it looks. I'm getting it, slowly.

cold.li: My progress is satisfactory.

plain.li: I'll just watch from the doorway, then.

blunt.li: Grown-ups never have time.

gloomy.li: Nobody wanted to teach me.

plain.li: Still haven't had a lesson.

cheerful.li: Is it lesson day yet?

ColonyCouncil.WishDef.label: a pet to look after
ColonyCouncil.WishDef.description: A child has been watching a small animal near the colony and wants one to look after. Any new animal the colony takes in will do.
ColonyCouncil.WishDef.fulfilledWhen: The colony takes in a new animal: tamed, bought or born.

plain.li: That {SUBJECT} is out by the trees again. Can we keep it? I'll feed it every day.
I've already named the {SUBJECT}. Please can someone catch it for me?
[morning] I saw the {SUBJECT} again this morning. It looked right at me.
[winter] The {SUBJECT} out there must be cold. It could sleep in my room.
[lowmood] If I had something to look after, I wouldn't feel so lonely.

warm.li: It would have a home, and I'd have a friend. Everybody wins.

blunt.li: I want a pet. That one.

cheerful.li: A pet, a real one! I'll teach it tricks.

gloomy.li: Everything I like ends up eaten. Not this one, please.

cold.li: An animal is useful, and I would be responsible for it.

plain.li: It ate out of my hand. I'm going to call it Button.

warm.li: Thank you, thank you. I'll look after it forever.

blunt.li: It's mine now. I'm in charge of it.

cheerful.li: It follows me everywhere, even to the latrine!

gloomy.li: I hope nobody eats it.

cold.li: I have taken responsibility for the animal.

plain.li: It ran away. Nobody caught it.

blunt.li: Grown-ups never let me have anything.

gloomy.li: I knew I couldn't have one.

plain.li: The {SUBJECT} is still out there.

ColonyCouncil.WishDef.label: new stories to read
ColonyCouncil.WishDef.description: A child has read every book in the colony at least twice and wants something new.
ColonyCouncil.WishDef.fulfilledWhen: The colony has {TARGET} books.

wants.reason: {PAWN_nameDef} has read every book in the colony at least twice.

plain.li: I've read all our books. Some of them three times. Can we get some new ones?
I want a book with a story in it. A long one, with monsters.
[night] If I had a book, I wouldn't need anyone to stay up with me.
[winter] It's too cold to play outside. I could read, if we had anything to read.
[rain] Rainy days are for reading, but there's nothing left to read.

warm.li: I could read them out loud to the little ones too.

blunt.li: I want new books.

cheerful.li: Books with dragons in, or pirates, or dragon pirates!

gloomy.li: I already know how all our stories end.

cold.li: My education is limited by the colony's books.

plain.li: A new book. I'm saving the last chapter for tomorrow.

warm.li: Thank you. I'll read to anyone who wants to listen.

blunt.li: Shh. I'm reading.

cheerful.li: There's a map at the front, and a monster on page nine!

gloomy.li: It has a sad ending. I read it anyway.

cold.li: Adequate reading material.

plain.li: I'll read the old ones again.

blunt.li: Nobody cares if kids read.

gloomy.li: Same stories, same endings.

plain.li: Still reading the same few books.

ColonyCouncil.WishDef.label: {THING} for the hottest days
ColonyCouncil.WishDef.description: It's sweltering outside and nowhere in the colony is cool. Someone wants a cooler, a passive one in a tribe, an electric one later.
ColonyCouncil.WishDef.fulfilledWhen: The colony has {THING}, or another cooler.

wants.reason: {PAWN_nameDef} can hardly breathe in this heat, and nowhere in the colony is cool.

plain.li: It's so hot I can't sleep, can't work, can't think. Somewhere cool, anywhere.
I've been lying on the stone floor at midday just to feel something cold.
[trigger:heat] This heat isn't letting up. We need a cool room before someone collapses.
[lowtech] In hot country they cool a room with wet clay and moving air. We could do the same.
[day] Midday, and the air in here is like soup.
[old] Heat like this is dangerous at my age. I need somewhere cool to rest.

warm.li: The children feel it worst. One cool room would help everyone.

blunt.li: Build {THING}. I'm melting.

cheerful.li: A cool room! I'll move in and you can all visit me there.

gloomy.li: Someone's going to faint out in the fields soon. Probably me.

cold.li: Heatstroke is preventable. Cooling costs less than treatment.

plain.li: Cool air. I stood in it for a while and didn't think about anything at all.

warm.li: Thank you. Everyone has been coming to sit in here.

blunt.li: Good. Close the door.

cheerful.li: It's lovely in here. I'm never leaving.

gloomy.li: Cool for now. Until it breaks.

cold.li: Temperature acceptable.

plain.li: I'll sweat it out, then.

blunt.li: When someone collapses, that's on you.

gloomy.li: Hot today, hotter tomorrow.

plain.li: Still nowhere cool to get out of the heat.

ColonyCouncil.WishDef.label: a proper pen for the animals
ColonyCouncil.WishDef.description: A keeper tired of chasing animals out of the fields wants a fenced pen for them.
ColonyCouncil.WishDef.fulfilledWhen: The colony has {THING}: a marked pen for its animals.

wants.reason: {PAWN_nameDef} keeps the animals and wants them penned where they belong.

plain.li: The animals wander into the fields and eat the crops. A fenced pen would keep them where they belong.
I spend half the day chasing animals back home. Let's fence off a pen.
[spring] The young ones will be born soon. They need somewhere safe to run.
[winter] Penned together they keep each other warm. Scattered, they freeze.
[afterraid] Raiders shot two of our animals out in the open. In a pen they'd be safer.
[lowtech] My family kept a pen of woven branches. The animals were calmer for it, and so were the crops.

warm.li: They're good animals. They deserve a place of their own.

blunt.li: Fence them in. I'm tired of chasing them.

cheerful.li: A pen with a gate and a trough! The animals will love it.

gloomy.li: One of them will wander off and get eaten. A pen would stop that.

cold.li: Penned animals graze where we want and don't trample the fields.

plain.li: All of them inside the fence, eating where they should. I can finally sit down.

warm.li: Thank you. They seem happier, I think.

blunt.li: Good. No more chasing.

cheerful.li: I counted them all in. Nobody missing.

gloomy.li: One has already found a hole in the fence. I'll fix it.

cold.li: Livestock contained.

plain.li: Back to chasing them, then.

blunt.li: When they eat the crops, don't look at me.

gloomy.li: They'll wander off, and that'll be that.

plain.li: Chased the animals out of the fields again today.
